name: Update Lead
description: Update a lead in HubSpot by id. Set **Object ID** and put the fields to change in **Object Properties** as HubSpot internal names. Look up the id with **Search CRM** if you only have a name. Example: Object ID `123`, Object Properties `{ "hs_lead_name": "Site B Expansion - Priority" }`. Returns the updated lead. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/beta-docs/guides/api/crm/objects/leads#update-leads)
